evidence.quote: The following tuition fees apply for applicants from: non-EU countries 1,000 EUR

Additionally, for applicants from outside of the European Economic Area (EEA) and without a German higher education entrance qualification: Motivation letter in the English language Curriculum vitae in tabulated format, written in the English language Scholastic aptitude test: SAT or TestAS (Core Test and Engineering Module) with a specific score.

notes: Tuition: the DAAD page states 1,000 EUR per semester for non-EU applicants and the Ohm page states "1.000,00 Euro pro Semester" for non-EEA students enrolling from winter semester 2026/27; Mechanical Engineering (B-MEC) is named as a tuition-charging programme. The DAAD quote gives the fee per semester, so no per-year conversion is made. The DAAD page states the fee is 1,000 EUR for non-EU applicants (not only for a first semester), so it is given as the programme's fee for this applicant. Duration: 7 semesters = 3.5 years. Application channel: no page names uni-assist, VPD or an application portal for this programme (DAAD says "Submit application via Please check this website."); the Ohm application-process page describes its own processes, so de-university-direct is used with a weak quote. Deadlines: the only date ranges found (2 May - 15 July winter; 15 November - 15 January summer) are without a year and are not stated to be for international/non-EU applicants, so no intake is given. The summer intake is stated to be only for transfer students with advanced standing.

note.fr: Pour les candidats hors EEE sans diplôme d'accès allemand : lettre de motivation en anglais, CV tabulaire en anglais et test d'aptitude (SAT ou TestAS avec un score spécifique) sont exigés.
note.en: For applicants from outside the EEA without a German higher education entrance qualification: motivation letter in English, tabulated CV in English and a scholastic aptitude test (SAT or TestAS with a specific score) are required.

evidence.quote: Additionally, for applicants from outside of the European Economic Area (EEA) and without a German higher education entrance qualification: Motivation letter in the English language Curriculum vitae in tabulated format, written in the English language Scholastic aptitude test: SAT or TestAS (Core Test and Engineering Module) with a specific score.
English language skills B2 required, please provide an official language certificate, e.g.: IELTS Academic: 6 TOEFL iBT (since 2026): 4.5 TOEFL iBT (before 2026): 80
German language skills A1 required, please provide an official language certificate, e.g.: telc Deutsch: telc Deutsch A1

note.fr: Une qualification d'accès à l'enseignement supérieur allemand (HZB, p. ex. Abitur ou Fachhochschulreife) est requise ; les certificats étrangers doivent être reconnus avec succès.
note.en: A German higher education entrance qualification (HZB, e.g. Abitur or Fachhochschulreife) is required; foreign certificates must be successfully recognised.

evidence.quote: For all applicants: A higher education entrance qualification for German universities is required ("Hochschulzugangsberechtigung (HZB)"), i.e. either general higher education entrance qualification ("Abitur") or university of applied sciences entrance qualification ("Fachhochschulreife"). For academic credentials (certificates) obtained outside of Germany, a successful recognition is necessary.
